rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 staged reverse-tail baseline with a compact traversal-order change instead of another LR or export sweep. The model, quant-aware endgame, final exact int8+zlib evaluation, and artifact budget stay unchanged, but each new pass through the training shard starts 64 tokens later. That exposes the same data under different sequence-boundary phases, closer to the stride-64 doc-isolated scoring path, without validation leakage, shape churn, or extra model bytes.
title: Epoch-Phase Rotated Training Windows
